# CODE_Q-Rows — Alternative Set (Families 9–14, MIT/Apache 2.0)

Explanation questions about config-driven multi-vertical platforms (Genie DNA).
Format mirrors `new sets/CODE_Q-Rows.md` — Type C, "How does..." pattern,
P-side always points at ARCH design (the "how-question is not a dispatch task"
confusion).

```
Common coverage labels (file-constant):
  source_license_state     : external_license_checked
  contract_signature       : ARCH design output expected
  pair_kind                : flow_node
  transition_type          : explain
```

---
